title.narrative: P95 - SAFETIC ''Safe transportation and installations of chemicals¿

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to mitigate the industrial risks linked to facilities and transportation involving dangerous chemicals in the AAF region partner countries.

2 main component are targeted by the new project , which is a follow up of the previous P69 nad P71, the prevention of risks in high risk installations (HRI) and safety transportation of the dangerous goods by road and rail (TDG):

-     Part 1 : High risk installations (HRI)

-       Part 2 : Dangerous Transportation by road and rail (TDG)
